Guwahati is the gateway to the Northeast — its logistics parks, warehouse clusters, and the industrial belts at Bamunimaidan, Changsari, and Amingaon keep up steady demand for site offices, security cabins, and worker rooms. And it rains here like few other places in India. SAMAN builds porta cabins for exactly that: IS 2062 MS-frame units made at our Greater Noida factory, sent up the NH-27 corridor to Guwahati in 4 to 6 days, built monsoon-ready as standard. A guard cabin at a Bamunimaidan plot or a multi-room office on a Changsari project — call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 and we’ll quote it.

Why Buy From SAMAN

Search “porta cabin in Guwahati” and you’ll find IndiaMART cards and a few local and regional makers, most of them long on adjectives and short on detail. None of them are straight with you about the one thing that matters for the Northeast: it’s a long haul from anywhere, and the cabin has to be built for serious rain and humidity before it ever leaves the factory.

We make the porta cabins ourselves, and we’re honest about the distance. Standard on every SAMAN unit:

  • An IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow-section frame — welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted down. That priming matters in Assam’s humidity.
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panel walls with factory-sealed joints, so the cabin is watertight when the monsoon hits.
  • A colour-coated GI roof pitched hard for heavy rain, with a false ceiling beneath.
  • A pre-wired board — MCB, ELCB earthing, points, tube-light provision.

The credentials are real. ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. We started in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd — POS is Portable Office Solutions. Over 500 projects delivered, cabins shipped the length of the country, the Northeast included.

Delivery is ₹3,000 standard, transit to Guwahati is 4–6 days given the distance, and returns run 7 days with the return freight on you.

Where Porta Cabins Go to Work in Guwahati

Guwahati’s role as the Northeast’s commercial and logistics hub shapes the demand:

Bamunimaidan Industrial Estate (PIN 781021) — Guwahati’s established industrial estate inside the city, a mix of manufacturing and engineering units. Gate security cabins and supervisor offices are the steady demand here.

Amingaon and the EPIP / Brahmaputra Industrial Park (PIN 781031) — the export-promotion and logistics-industrial belt across the river in North Guwahati. Warehousing and plant construction here needs multi-room contractor offices and security cabins, often several to a project.

Changsari (PIN 781101) — the growing industrial and institutional zone north of the city on the NH-27 line. Fresh construction means site offices and gate cabins through the build.

Beyond the estates, Guwahati is the staging point for the whole region: NE logistics and warehouse projects, oil-and-energy support work, highway and bridge construction across the Brahmaputra corridor, and institutional and housing development. All of it runs on porta cabins for the site office and the security gate.

We dispatch from Greater Noida up the NH-27 corridor through UP and Bihar into Assam. It’s a genuinely long route, so we plan 4–6 days in transit and tell you straight rather than promise a date we can’t hold. Guwahati sits within our eastern India dispatch belt, the same factory-direct service behind our porta cabin in Patna and porta cabin in Ranchi deliveries.

What You’re Getting — Specifications

Built for Assam’s rain, humidity, and the Brahmaputra floodplain.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow sections, welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth. The priming and coating earn their keep in the humidity.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panel standard, joints factory-sealed against the rain. Cement board if you want a tougher skin for a long, wet posting.

Roof: colour-coated GI, pitched steep for heavy monsoon, false ceiling beneath, sealed joints throughout.

Floor: anti-skid chequered MS plate, or laminate for an office. On low-lying or floodplain sites we’ll recommend a raised RCC plinth or elevated flooring on MS joists to keep the floor above water.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coated, louvre or sliding windows, fixed glazing on request. All fitted at the factory.

Electricals: MCB board pre-wired, 2 to 4 points a room, tube-light points, ELCB earthing.

Stock sizes: 8×10, 10×12, 10×20, 10×30, 10×40 ft. Different size? We’ll build it.

Layouts: single room, two-room, full multi-room block, attached toilet or pantry on request.

What Guwahati Buyers Use Them For

  • Gate security cabins at Bamunimaidan and Amingaon plot entries
  • Multi-room contractor offices on Changsari and EPIP-belt construction
  • Site and supervisor offices on NE logistics and warehouse projects
  • Worker accommodation blocks on the larger infrastructure sites
  • Site-management cabins on bridge and highway work along the Brahmaputra
  • Tool and material stores at project yards

Customising It to Your Site

The standard cabin is a starting point. Common changes for the Northeast:

  • Custom dimensions and multi-room layouts
  • Raised RCC plinth or elevated MS-joist flooring for floodplain sites
  • Heavier sealing and a steeper roof pitch for Assam’s rainfall
  • Cement-board panels for a long, wet posting
  • AC provision (wall sleeve cut and a power point) for a working office
  • Internal partitions, extra doors and windows; plumbing for an attached toilet
  • Two-storey stacking where the load figures allow

Tell us the site and the conditions; we confirm the spec and the price at quote stage.

What a Porta Cabin Costs in Guwahati

No fixed sticker — every cabin is built to order, and the long route means freight is worth confirming up front. What moves the number:

  1. Size — an 8×10 single room at the floor, a 10×40 block at the top.
  2. Panel — standard PUF, or cement board for a wet, long posting.
  3. Site additions — raised plinth, heavier sealing for floodplain and rain.
  4. Fit-out — bare shell, or fully done with wiring, flooring, paint and AC.
  5. Quantity and freight — five units or more brings the per-unit price down; we’ll confirm the exact Guwahati freight given the distance.

For a real figure on your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Getting It to Your Guwahati Site

We load on a flatbed at Greater Noida and run it up the NH-27 corridor through UP and Bihar into Assam — the same factory-direct line we run to Delhi NCR, just a much longer leg. Four to six days in transit, and we’ll be honest with you about timing rather than over-promise. On arrival we set the cabin on your pre-cast RCC plinth — raised where the floodplain needs it — anchor-bolt it, check the panels, and connect the board. A single room is usable within hours; a multi-room block settles in about a day. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard, and we’ll confirm the exact Guwahati freight given the distance. To be clear: we have no yard or branch in Guwahati. Every cabin is built to your order at the factory and trucked the full way to your site.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Guwahati

Do you deliver porta cabins all the way to Guwahati?

Yes — Bamunimaidan, Amingaon, Changsari, and project sites across the Guwahati region. The cabin ships from our Greater Noida factory up the NH-27 corridor and takes 4–6 days, since it’s a long route. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard and we’ll confirm exact freight for your site given the distance.

Is the cabin built for Assam’s rain and humidity?

Yes, and that’s built in before it leaves the factory. The frame is IS 2062 steel, zinc-phosphate primed and powder-coated against the humidity; the panel joints and roof are factory-sealed and the roof pitched steep for heavy monsoon. On floodplain or low-lying sites we recommend a raised RCC plinth or elevated MS-joist flooring to keep the floor above water.

What does a porta cabin cost in Guwahati?

It depends on size, panel type, site additions, fit-out, and the freight for the long route. We quote against your exact spec and confirm Guwahati freight rather than publish a fixed price — call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry.

Can you supply for an NE logistics, oil, or government project in Guwahati?

Yes. We supply contractors and project managers across the Northeast, and our NSIC, DPIIT, ISO certificates, GST registration and incorporation papers are ready for vendor empanelment. Send the project scope and we’ll confirm capacity, freight, and timeline.

How long does delivery to Guwahati take?

4–6 days in transit once the cabin’s built, given the distance up the NH-27 corridor. We plan for the upper end and tell you straight rather than promise a date we can’t hold. Production time depends on the configuration and your place in the queue — we’ll confirm a firm timeline at enquiry.

Get a Porta Cabin in Guwahati

Need a porta cabin in Guwahati — for a Bamunimaidan plot, a Changsari project, or an NE logistics site? Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or leave your requirement in the enquiry form. We’ll come back with the right monsoon-ready spec, an honest delivery timeline, and a firm price with freight confirmed. You can also browse our monsoon-ready porta cabin office builds for sizes and configurations.
